description: Six floors in three steps with its west flank blank all the way up, because it was built against the Curtain, and the estate went to the trouble of getting a party wall award for a boundary with nothing on the other side of it. It was moved here when the Coliseum grew, flank and all. The paperwork for that is framed in the estate office and is regarded there as a masterpiece. The door is at the east end of the bottom step, off Windrow Lane, as far from the blank flank as the building can put it.
name: 2 Kerbstone Row
